fieldValues.title: RFC-002: ext:themes-l1 — Visual Theming for Document Views
fieldValues.content: Defines the `ext:themes-l1` extension, attaching a non-destructive `Theme` (assets, element/page templates, stylesheet, CSS-class injection) to a `DocumentView`, with graceful degradation for implementations that do not support it. Full text: rfcs/rfc-002.md.

sourceRefs.note: RFC-002 from srs-spec.md - coarse source anchoring during migration
